% 脱敏示例论文（head 版本）
\documentclass[11pt]{article}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\title{Attention Is All You Need}
\begin{document}
\maketitle
We propose a new architecture for sequence transduction.
The model is based on self-attention mechanisms.
\begin{align}
  h_t = \mathrm{softmax}(QK^T / \sqrt{d_k}) V
\end{align}
We evaluate our approach on machine translation.
Our experiments show strong results on WMT 2014.
\end{document}
